content: For Svelte 5 Runes popover (click-triggered floating card), the two viable options are: (1) bits-ui Popover component (v2.18.1) — headless, built on Floating UI, Svelte 5 native with Runes (, ), clean Popover.Root/Trigger/Content API, handles positioning and collision detection automatically, no additional config needed; (2) @floating-ui/dom with manual Svelte 5 wiring — more control but more boilerplate. The skeletonlabs/floating-ui-svelte package was archived October 2025 and is deprecated — do not use. Recommendation: bits-ui Popover is the cleanest path for this project given it already uses Tailwind and needs a simple popover card.
